title: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἀγοράζει τὸν ἄρτον
learning_goal: Practice impersonal δεῖ + infinitive, θέλω/δύναμαι + infinitive, and trade verbs (ἀγοράζω/πωλέω) alongside basic-need verb πεινᾷ in a simple market errand.
plot: Hungry Dinosaur takes coins, goes to the agora, buys bread from a merchant, and eats until he is no longer hungry.

frames.text: ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ἐστὶν ὁ Δεινόσαυρος. πεινᾷ· θέλει φαγεῖν τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: A low round honey-oak wooden table with a smooth worn top and sturdy legs in warm oak brown.
Several small bronze and silver coins, round and slightly worn, gleaming softly.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur stands center-left in close view, three-quarter toward the right, looking down at his belly with both hands resting on it.
A low round honey-oak wooden table sits to the right background, top visible under warm light.
Several small bronze and silver coins lie in a small scattered pile near the near edge of the table.
A small brown cloth sack with drawstring rests open on the table beside the coins, mouth gaping toward the viewer.
motivations: Dinosaur’s stomach has just growled at home; he feels hungry and wants to eat bread soon.
frames.artist_notes: Close on tummy hands; softly suggest a belly rumble without text.

frames.text: ζητεῖ τὸν ἄρτον, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἄρτος.
objects: A low round honey-oak wooden table with a smooth worn top and sturdy legs in warm oak brown.
Several small bronze and silver coins, round and slightly worn, gleaming softly.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur stands left midground, three-quarter right view, scanning the room and then the table with a hopeful look.
The low round honey-oak table fills the center, its top clearly visible.
Several small bronze and silver coins remain on the near edge of the table.
The small brown cloth sack sits open on the tabletop to the right of the coins.
motivations: Dinosaur is looking for bread at home but cannot find any on the table, so disappointment shows.
frames.artist_notes: Pan from Dinosaur to the table; keep warm indoor lighting.

frames.text: δεῖ ἀγοράζειν τὸν ἄρτον· δεῖ πορεύεσθαι εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: A low round honey-oak wooden table with a smooth worn top and sturdy legs in warm oak brown.
Several small bronze and silver coins, round and slightly worn, gleaming softly.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur is at the left edge, only his arm and snout visible as he leans in, three-quarter right, looking at the coins.
The low round honey-oak table fills the frame bottom; wood grain clear.
Several small bronze and silver coins sit center-foreground in tight focus.
The small brown cloth sack lies open beside the coins with its drawstring slack.
motivations: Realizing there is no bread at home, Dinosaur decides he must go to the market to buy bread.
frames.artist_notes: Tight close-up on coins and sack; shallow depth of field.

frames.text: εὑρίσκει ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης τὰ νομίσματα· λαμβάνει καὶ τίθησιν εἰς τὸν σάκκον· φέρει τὸν σάκκον.
objects: A low round honey-oak wooden table with a smooth worn top and sturdy legs in warm oak brown.
Several small bronze and silver coins, round and slightly worn, gleaming softly.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur stands center-right, three-quarter right view, eyes on his hands as he scoops coins toward the open sack.
The low round honey-oak table sits low in the foreground under his hands.
Several small bronze and silver coins are half in his palm and half sliding toward the sack’s mouth.
The small brown cloth sack sits open on the table as coins drop inside; drawstring hanging outward.
motivations: Determined to buy bread, Dinosaur gathers the coins into the sack and prepares to carry it out.
frames.artist_notes: Keep the motion clear: coins moving from table into sack.

frames.text: ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου καὶ βαδίζει εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν· δεῖ ἰέναι ἀγοράζειν τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: A winding cobblestone path of small gray stones leading from the house.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur steps from the door onto the path, side view facing right, looking down the road while holding the sack at his hip.
A winding cobblestone path runs across the foreground, curving gently to the right.
The small brown cloth sack hangs from Dinosaur’s right hand at his side.
motivations: Carrying coins in the sack, Dinosaur leaves home to go buy bread at the market.
frames.artist_notes: Tracking feel: slight motion lines on feet and path stones.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἥκει πρὸς τὴν ἀγοράν καὶ εἰσέρχεται.
objects: Sturdy white Doric columns with simple capitals lining the stoa entrance.
Low limestone steps, smooth and slightly worn, leading up to the colonnade.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur is at the base of the steps, three-quarter right view, looking up toward the columns as he climbs.
Sturdy white Doric columns frame the entrance across the background, receding in perspective.
Low limestone steps fill the lower center as a short gentle stair toward the colonnade.
The small brown cloth sack swings lightly from Dinosaur’s hand as he moves upward.
motivations: After walking from home, Dinosaur has reached the market entrance and is eager to go inside to find bread.
frames.artist_notes: Dolly-in feel toward the colonnade; bright sun with soft shadows.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος περιπατεῖ πρὸς τὸν ἔμπορον.
objects: A chalk-white display table in the stoa, neatly arranged, with a flat top and simple cedar legs.
A crusty round loaf of wheat bread the size of a child's head, golden-brown with a flour-dusted top.
A woven basket filled with red-green apples, smooth and shiny.
A tall terracotta jug of water with a narrow neck and simple painted rings.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur enters from left foreground, three-quarter right view, looking ahead at the merchant with a hopeful expression.
Emporos stands behind the display table on the right, front view, smiling and looking toward Dinosaur.
A chalk-white display table sits right foreground, top clear and inviting.
A crusty round loaf of wheat bread rests near the center of the table.
A woven basket of red-green apples sits to the left side on the table.
A tall terracotta jug of water stands at the right corner of the table.
The small brown cloth sack hangs from Dinosaur’s right hand as he walks.
motivations: Dinosaur is approaching the seller to get bread because he is hungry.
Emporos is a cheerful merchant ready to sell goods to the new customer.
frames.artist_notes: Soft daylight from the colonnade; gentle crowd hints in background.

frames.text: ὁ ἔμπορος πωλεῖ τὸν ἄρτον καὶ τὰ μῆλα καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ.
objects: A chalk-white display table in the stoa, neatly arranged, with a flat top and simple cedar legs.
A crusty round loaf of wheat bread the size of a child's head, golden-brown with a flour-dusted top.
A woven basket filled with red-green apples, smooth and shiny.
A tall terracotta jug of water with a narrow neck and simple painted rings.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur peeks from left edge, three-quarter right view, eyes on the bread.
Emporos stands behind the table, three-quarter left view, gesturing open-handed toward the goods and looking at Dinosaur.
The chalk-white display table fills the center foreground.
The crusty round loaf of bread sits center on the table in close focus.
The woven basket of apples sits left on the table, apples catching light.
The tall terracotta water jug stands right on the table.
The small brown cloth sack hangs low from Dinosaur’s hand at the frame edge.
motivations: Dinosaur studies the offered goods, mainly the bread he wants to eat.
Emporos highlights his goods to encourage the purchase.
frames.artist_notes: Close on merchandise; keep hands and welcoming gesture clear.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐκ τοῦ σάκκου λαμβάνει τὰ νομίσματα.
objects: A chalk-white display table in the stoa, neatly arranged, with a flat top and simple cedar legs.
A crusty round loaf of wheat bread the size of a child's head, golden-brown with a flour-dusted top.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
Several small bronze and silver coins, round and slightly worn, gleaming softly.
positioning: Dinosaur stands left foreground, three-quarter right view, looking into his open sack as his hand reaches inside.
Emporos stands right behind the table, front view, watching the coins with a patient smile.
The chalk-white display table sits right foreground with its front edge visible.
The crusty round loaf of bread rests near the front edge of the table within reach.
The small brown cloth sack is held open in Dinosaur’s left hand near his waist.
Several small bronze and silver coins glint in Dinosaur’s right fingertips as they emerge from the sack.
motivations: Dinosaur is retrieving coins to pay so he can buy the bread.
Emporos waits attentively, ready to accept payment.
frames.artist_notes: Tight focus on the hand and coins; keep the loaf visible to tie the action.

frames.text: δίδωσι τὰ νομίσματα τῷ ἐμπόρῳ καὶ ἀγοράζει τὸν ἄρτον· δύναται ἀγοράζειν, ἔχει γὰρ τὰ νομίσματα.
objects: A chalk-white display table in the stoa, neatly arranged, with a flat top and simple cedar legs.
A crusty round loaf of wheat bread the size of a child's head, golden-brown with a flour-dusted top.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
Several small bronze and silver coins, round and slightly worn, gleaming softly.
positioning: Dinosaur stands left, three-quarter right view, extending his hand with coins toward the merchant while looking up at him.
Emporos stands right behind the table, three-quarter left view, reaching out to accept the coins and glancing kindly at Dinosaur.
The chalk-white display table remains between them, front edge parallel to the frame.
The crusty round loaf of bread sits ready on the table near Emporos’ hands.
The small brown cloth sack hangs from Dinosaur’s left hand at his side.
Several small bronze and silver coins pass from Dinosaur’s right hand to Emporos’ palm above the table.
motivations: Dinosaur gladly pays because he can now buy the bread with his coins.
Emporos accepts the payment and prepares to complete the sale.
frames.artist_notes: Hands meeting above the table form the focus; keep faces in gentle smiles.

frames.text: ὁ ἔμπορος δίδωσιν αὐτῷ τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: A chalk-white display table in the stoa, neatly arranged, with a flat top and simple cedar legs.
A crusty round loaf of wheat bread the size of a child's head, golden-brown with a flour-dusted top.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur stands left, front view, reaching out with both hands to receive the loaf while looking at it with delight.
Emporos stands right behind the table, front view, handing the loaf forward and looking at Dinosaur warmly.
The chalk-white display table remains steady between them, slightly lower in the frame.
The crusty round loaf of bread is mid-transfer between Emporos’ and Dinosaur’s hands.
The small brown cloth sack hangs at Dinosaur’s left side.
motivations: Dinosaur is happy to receive the bread at last.
Emporos completes the sale by giving the loaf to Dinosaur.
frames.artist_notes: Center the loaf as the handoff moment; soft daylight on the bread.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐσθίει τὸν ἄρτον· νῦν οὐ πεινᾷ.
objects: A chalk-white display table in the stoa, neatly arranged, with a flat top and simple cedar legs.
A crusty round loaf of wheat bread the size of a child's head, golden-brown with a flour-dusted top.
A small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled.
positioning: Dinosaur stands center, three-quarter left view, holding the loaf with both hands near his mouth and looking at it joyfully as he takes a bite.
Emporos stands behind the table in the background right, three-quarter left view, watching with a satisfied smile.
The chalk-white display table sits right background, slightly out of focus.
The crusty round loaf of bread is in Dinosaur’s hands, a bite missing near the top.
The small brown cloth sack now hangs behind Dinosaur’s elbow at his left side.
motivations: Dinosaur eats the bread he bought and feels satisfied because he is no longer hungry.
Emporos is pleased seeing the customer enjoy the purchase.
frames.artist_notes: Push in on Dinosaur’s happy bite; keep crumbs gentle and tidy.
